toefl:se:202.japanese: トレンディウォークス カスタマーサービスチーム様、
toefl:se:202.explanation: 会社名+部署名を含むフォーマルな宛名の書き方。
toefl:se:202.relatedInfo: Dear [Company] Support Team, / To the Customer Service Department,

toefl:se:203.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:203.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this message finds you well
toefl:se:203.japanese: このメッセージが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:203.relatedInfo: I hope you are having a good day. / I trust you are well.

toefl:se:204.answer: I'm writing about an issue with my recent order.
toefl:se:204.fullSentence: I'm writing about an issue with my recent order.
toefl:se:204.japanese: 最近の注文についての問題でご連絡しております。
toefl:se:204.explanation: writing aboutは用件を簡潔に述べる表現。
toefl:se:204.relatedInfo: contacting you regarding my order / reaching out about a recent purchase

toefl:se:205.answer: I ordered a pair of sneakers in size 9 and navy blue from your online store, but I received a size 8 in black instead.
toefl:se:205.fullSentence: I ordered a pair of sneakers in size 9 and navy blue from your online store, but I received a size 8 in black instead.
keyPhrases: ordered a pair of sneakers in size 9 and navy blue
received a size 8 in black instead
toefl:se:205.japanese: 御社のオンラインストアでサイズ9、ネイビーブルーのスニーカーを注文しましたが、代わりにサイズ8の黒が届きました。
toefl:se:205.explanation: instead で文末に「代わりに」を添える語順。
toefl:se:205.relatedInfo: got a different size and color / received the wrong pair

toefl:se:206.answer: This mix-up has caused quite an inconvenience, as I intended the shoes for an upcoming event next week, and the incorrect size and color mean I cannot wear them as planned.
toefl:se:206.fullSentence: This mix-up has caused quite an inconvenience, as I intended the shoes for an upcoming event next week, and the incorrect size and color mean I cannot wear them as planned.
toefl:se:206.japanese: 来週の予定されているイベント用にこの靴を考えていたため、この行き違いはかなりの不便をもたらしており、サイズと色が間違っているため予定通りに履くことができません。
toefl:se:206.explanation: mix-upは「取り違え、混同」という意味の名詞。
toefl:se:206.relatedInfo: created a real inconvenience / thrown off my plans

toefl:se:207.answer: Additionally, I now have to make alternative arrangements at short notice, which is quite stressful.
toefl:se:207.fullSentence: Additionally, I now have to make alternative arrangements at short notice, which is quite stressful.
keyPhrases: make alternative arrangements at short notice
toefl:se:207.japanese: さらに、急な代替の手配をしなければならず、これはかなりストレスです。
toefl:se:207.explanation: at short noticeで「急に、突然に」という意味。
toefl:se:207.relatedInfo: scramble for a backup plan / arrange things last minute

toefl:se:208.answer: I kindly request a solution to this issue, preferably an exchange for the correct size and color I originally ordered.
toefl:se:208.fullSentence: I kindly request a solution to this issue, preferably an exchange for the correct size and color I originally ordered.
keyPhrases: correct size and color i originally ordered
toefl:se:208.japanese: この問題の解決策として、できれば元々注文した正しいサイズと色への交換をお願いしたく存じます。
toefl:se:208.explanation: preferablyで「できれば」という希望の優先順位を示す。
toefl:se:208.relatedInfo: ideally an exchange / would prefer an exchange

toefl:se:209.answer: If an exchange is not feasible, I would appreciate a refund.
toefl:se:209.fullSentence: If an exchange is not feasible, I would appreciate a refund.
keyPhrases: if an exchange is not feasible
toefl:se:209.japanese: 交換が難しい場合は、返金をいただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:209.explanation: would appreciateは丁寧な希望を表すビジネス表現。
toefl:se:209.relatedInfo: if a replacement can't be arranged / should an exchange not be possible

toefl:se:210.answer: Please let me know how to proceed with returning the incorrect pair and obtaining the right item.
toefl:se:210.fullSentence: Please let me know how to proceed with returning the incorrect pair and obtaining the right item.
toefl:se:210.japanese: 間違った靴の返品方法と正しい商品の入手方法についてお知らせください。
toefl:se:210.explanation: how to proceed withで「〜する進め方」という表現。
toefl:se:210.relatedInfo: the return process / how to get the correct item

toefl:se:211.answer: Thank you for your attention and prompt assistance with this matter.
toefl:se:211.fullSentence: Thank you for your attention and prompt assistance with this matter.
toefl:se:211.japanese: 本件へのご配慮と迅速なご対応に感謝申し上げます。
toefl:se:211.explanation: Thank you for〜は感謝を伝える結びの定型表現。
toefl:se:211.relatedInfo: appreciate your prompt help / thank you for handling this quickly

toefl:se:212.answer: I look forward to your swift response.
toefl:se:212.fullSentence: I look forward to your swift response.
keyPhrases: look forward to your swift response
toefl:se:212.japanese: 迅速なご返信をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:212.explanation: swift responseで「迅速な返信」を表す。
toefl:se:212.relatedInfo: a prompt reply / hearing back from you soon

toefl:se:213.japanese: カスタマーサービス様、
toefl:se:213.explanation: フォーマルなメールの書き出し。
toefl:se:213.relatedInfo: Dear Support Team, / Dear Sir or Madam,

toefl:se:214.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:214.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this email finds you well
toefl:se:214.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:214.relatedInfo: I hope you're having a good day. / I hope everything is well.

toefl:se:215.answer: I recently bought a pair of shoes from your online store, but unfortunately, I received a product that was different from what I ordered.
toefl:se:215.fullSentence: I recently bought a pair of shoes from your online store, but unfortunately, I received a product that was different from what I ordered.
keyPhrases: recently bought a pair of shoes
toefl:se:215.japanese: 最近御社のオンラインストアで靴を購入しましたが、残念ながら注文したものとは異なる商品が届きました。
toefl:se:215.explanation: unfortunatelyで残念な事実を導入する副詞。
toefl:se:215.relatedInfo: received the wrong item / got something different from my order

toefl:se:216.answer: I purchased a small size in red, but I received a large size in blue instead.
toefl:se:216.fullSentence: I purchased a small size in red, but I received a large size in blue instead.
keyPhrases: purchased a small size in red
received a large size in blue instead
toefl:se:216.japanese: 私は赤のSサイズを購入しましたが、代わりに青のLサイズが届きました。
toefl:se:216.explanation: but〜insteadで注文と届いた商品の対比を表す。
toefl:se:216.relatedInfo: was sent the wrong size and color / got a mismatched item

toefl:se:217.answer: Because of this mistake, I am unable to wear the shoes, which has caused me inconvenience as I needed them for an event this week.
toefl:se:217.fullSentence: Because of this mistake, I am unable to wear the shoes, which has caused me inconvenience as I needed them for an event this week.
keyPhrases: needed them for an event this week
toefl:se:217.japanese: この間違いのせいで靴を履くことができず、今週のイベントで必要だったため不便を被っています。
toefl:se:217.explanation: be unable to doで「〜できない」というフォーマルな否定表現。
toefl:se:217.relatedInfo: can't wear them as intended / left me without proper footwear

toefl:se:218.answer: I would appreciate it if you could help me exchange the shoes for the correct size and color.
toefl:se:218.fullSentence: I would appreciate it if you could help me exchange the shoes for the correct size and color.
keyPhrases: would appreciate it if you could help me exchange
toefl:se:218.japanese: 靴を正しいサイズと色に交換していただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:218.explanation: would appreciate it if you could〜は非常に丁寧な依頼表現。
toefl:se:218.relatedInfo: it would be great if you could / I'd be grateful if you could

toefl:se:219.answer: Please let me know how I can proceed with the exchange.
toefl:se:219.fullSentence: Please let me know how I can proceed with the exchange.
keyPhrases: how i can proceed with the exchange
toefl:se:219.japanese: 交換の手続き方法をお知らせください。
toefl:se:219.explanation: Please let me know how〜は依頼の定型表現。
toefl:se:219.relatedInfo: advise me on the exchange process / let me know the next steps

toefl:se:220.japanese: カスタマーサポート様、
toefl:se:220.explanation: フォーマルな書き出し。
toefl:se:220.relatedInfo: Dear Support Team, / To Customer Support,

toefl:se:221.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:221.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
keyPhrases: i hope this message finds you well
toefl:se:221.japanese: このメッセージが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:221.relatedInfo: I hope this note finds you well. / Hope you're doing great.

toefl:se:222.answer: I'm writing to bring to your attention an issue with my recent sneaker order.
toefl:se:222.fullSentence: I'm writing to bring to your attention an issue with my recent sneaker order.
keyPhrases: bring to your attention an issue
toefl:se:222.japanese: 最近のスニーカー注文の問題についてお伝えしたく、ご連絡しています。
toefl:se:222.explanation: bring 物 to one's attentionで「〜に知らせる」を表す。
toefl:se:222.relatedInfo: flag a problem with / notify you of an issue with

toefl:se:223.answer: I placed an order for a pair of sneakers last week, selecting the size 9 in black.
toefl:se:223.fullSentence: I placed an order for a pair of sneakers last week, selecting the size 9 in black.
toefl:se:223.japanese: 先週、サイズ9の黒を選んでスニーカーを注文しました。
toefl:se:223.explanation: selectingは分詞構文で付帯状況を表す。
toefl:se:223.relatedInfo: choosing size 9 in black / opting for black in size 9

toefl:se:224.answer: However, upon receiving the package yesterday, I discovered that the sneakers were a size 7 in white.
toefl:se:224.fullSentence: However, upon receiving the package yesterday, I discovered that the sneakers were a size 7 in white.
toefl:se:224.japanese: しかし、昨日荷物を受け取った際、届いたスニーカーがサイズ7の白であることに気づきました。
toefl:se:224.explanation: upon -ingは「〜するとすぐに」というフォーマルな時の表現。
toefl:se:224.relatedInfo: upon opening the box / when the package arrived

toefl:se:225.answer: This mix-up is causing me quite a bit of inconvenience.
toefl:se:225.fullSentence: This mix-up is causing me quite a bit of inconvenience.
toefl:se:225.japanese: この行き違いは私にかなりの不便をもたらしています。
toefl:se:225.explanation: quite a bit ofで「かなりの量の」を表す。
toefl:se:225.relatedInfo: this error is causing trouble / this mistake is quite disruptive

toefl:se:226.answer: I had planned to wear the sneakers for an upcoming event this weekend, and the wrong size and color mean I can't do so.
toefl:se:226.fullSentence: I had planned to wear the sneakers for an upcoming event this weekend, and the wrong size and color mean I can't do so.
toefl:se:226.japanese: 今週末の予定されているイベントでこのスニーカーを履くつもりでしたが、間違ったサイズと色のためそれができません。
toefl:se:226.explanation: had plannedは過去完了で予定していたことを表す。
toefl:se:226.relatedInfo: was going to wear them for / had intended to use them for
